title: Validity of snapshot sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $W$ be a natural number, let $t_0$ be a Boolean, and let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the eleven registers. If register $I$ has value at least $1$, and register $LB$ has value at least $1$ whenever $t_0$ is false, then every source in the snapshot source list of width $W$ and tape count $k$ is valid for $\rho$: its input position is strictly before register $Z$ when it reads register $PA$, and each referenced register block has a positive index.
hypotheses_covered: Register I has value at least 1
If t0 is false, register LB has value at least 1
